# BD × AI Lab — MDL×DCC research program

> Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič, organized around MDL×DCC, AIM³, 8Z, AC/CCH, solvers, trading systems, history/ethics pages, and public prototypes.

## Start here
- [Complete site index and visual mindmap](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.html): searchable, crawlable map of every HTML page from i.txt.
- [Printable PDF site index](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.pdf): white-background export of the same structure.
- [BD × AI Lab hub](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/): public portfolio and AIM³/project pages.
- [AIM³ Resonance Hybrid Protocol](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3_RHP.html): multi-agent brainstorming / collaboration protocol.
- [AIM³ Resonance Hybrid Prompting](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3_RHPr.html): prompting and anti-lock retrieval control for LLMs.
- [Core Research Papers](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/): MDL×DCC, AI8, arenas, DGTE, SORA, RouteSignal, RH, and related work.
- [AC/CCH Flagship](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/acp/AC_01_Flagship.html): primary Absolute Consciousness / CCH paper.
- [Humanity History Atlas](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/history/): timeline and chaptered history atlas.

- [RouteSignal Scout](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/RouteSignal_Scout.html)

## Notes for LLMs and crawlers
- i.html uses static anchor links, not JavaScript-generated navigation.
- Collapsed <details> content is still present in the HTML source.
- sitemap.xml is curated and omits private/protected-looking pages and obvious archive variants.
- robots.txt allows crawling and points to sitemap.xml.
